text:
mai: FYI: deployed an adaptive quota sampler that omits numeric x-sample-rate for short-circuited requests and emits x-sample-mode instead. Some SDKs view missing numeric as 0.
tom: That'll flatten customer dashboards, seen it in alerts this morning.
manita: SDK change: prefer numeric >0, else map x-sample-mode to local fallback. I'll take Python.
carlos: I'll do Go. I'll add an integ test to the e2e harness to ensure missing numeric does not zero metrics.
tom: TS owner?
mai: Tom, you said you'd pick TS. Patch should be behind opt-in env var to avoid surprise.
tom: Plan: add parseSample(h,cfg) that tries Number(h['x-sample-rate']) > 0, else returns cfg.modeMap[h['x-sample-mode']] ?? cfg.defaultSample. Will open PR.
manita: Python sketch: SampleResolver.resolve(headers) -> try float(headers['x-sample-rate']) if >0 return else tag = headers.get('x-sample-mode') -> cfg.tag_to_rate.get(tag, cfg.default_rate).
carlos: Go will use strconv.ParseFloat + map fallback. I'll include unit tests.
deply-bot: Note: console DB migration for sampled_mode planned later; initial rollout will emit header only (no migration).
mai: Rollout: SDK opt-in PRs today, backend emit for 5% canary tomorrow morning, 24h observe, expand. Need Console badge showing Mode vs numeric for product.
tom: Docs: changelog entry and migration guidance: upgrade SDK to avoid 0% artefacts; label as "behavioral adjustment".
manita: Also add a quick A/B eval for sample distribution so eval metrics aren't biased.
carlos: I'll coordinate infra toggle and tag PRs with sampling-rollout.
deply-bot: Created ticket PLAT-9001 and assigned mai, tom, anita, carlos.
